SEC. 7114. CARRYOVER OF FUNDS FOR EXTENSION AT 1890 LAND-GRANT 
                          COLLEGES, INCLUDING TUSKEGEE UNIVERSITY.

and Teaching Policy Act of 1977 (7 U.S.C. 3221(a)) is amended by
